items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I liked Stan Getz, you know. He was playing very well at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh yeah, yeah. So I went to the concert and...I tell you what happened. Duke Ellington's Band...Charlie Parker and strings, Stan Getz and Billie Holiday closed the show. So I sit up there and listened to all this wonderful music and, when they finished, Billie Holiday got up there and started singin', it was like you had never heard anything all night. I says, 'My God!' So, hahaha, I'm tellin' ya, everybody was speechless, I'm tellin' ya. She just took out everything. You forgot anything that happened…
Yeah, I want to bear down and get some
